get.description:
The whole board in one read — cards grouped by column, in board order.

``GET boards/{id}/tasks`` is a keyset FEED (``-created_at``), which is
the wrong order for a kanban view: a card's place is its fractional
``position`` inside its column. This read answers board-shaped —
columns in ``order``, cards grouped by column key and sorted by
``position`` — un-paginated and capped by ``BOARD_CARDS_MAX`` with a
``truncated`` flag, so a client renders a board in one round trip
instead of draining pages and re-sorting.

**Permissions:** `IsAuthenticated`
get.summary: Read a whole board (cards grouped by column, position order)

BoardCardsResponse.description:
A whole board in one read: its columns, and its cards grouped by column.

The paginated ``GET boards/{id}/tasks`` answers in ``-created_at`` order
(a feed), but a card's place on a board is its fractional ``position``
within its column. This read is the board-shaped one: every non-archived
card, grouped by column key, each group ordered by ``position``, columns
in board order — the same shape the ``tasks.list_board`` comm Function
returns. Un-paginated and capped by ``BOARD_CARDS_MAX``.

columns.description: The board's columns in display order

cards.description: Card lists keyed by column key; every column key is present

truncated.description: True when the cap cut the answer short — the client must

preset.description: Board preset key (default "simple"); ignored if columns given

key.description: Preset key to pass as ``preset`` when creating a board

columns.description: The columns a board created from it starts with

BoardVocabularyResponse.description:
Everything a board-creation form needs that is otherwise undiscoverable.

Presets, the fixed column-category vocabulary, the checklist states and
the host's configured priority scale (``priority`` itself is an
unconstrained int in the table — this is the scale a client offers).

priority_scale.description: The configured priority steps (may be empty)

ref.description: Opaque id of an external step this item mirrors

ColumnCreateRequest.description: Add a column to a board.

keys.description: Column keys in the desired order

key.description: Stable machine key = the card's status

name_key.description: Optional i18n key for the display name

order.description: Position of the column on the board

wip_limit.description: Optional WIP limit (stored, not enforced in v1)

reason_key.description: Localizable reason key when denied (else null)

PatchedBoardUpdateRequest.description: Patch a board (only provided fields change).

PatchedTaskUpdateRequest.description: Patch a card (only provided fields change).

PresetColumnResponse.description: One column of a board preset.

key.description: Stable machine key the created column will carry

name_key.description: Optional i18n key for the display name

PriorityLevelResponse.description: One step of the configured priority scale.

value.description: The integer written to a card's ``priority``

label_key.description: i18n key a client renders for this step

assignee_ids.description: The new full set of assignee user ids

column.description: Target column key (defaults to the first column)

index.description: Target index within the column (append if omitted)

TaskPageResponse.description:
One keyset page of the card feed (``GET boards/{id}/tasks``).

The envelope stapel-core's anchor pagination answers with. Note the
order is ``-created_at`` — a feed, not the board shape; read
``BoardCardsResponse`` for the latter.

next_anchor.description: Anchor to pass as ``anchor`` for the next page (null at the end)

prev_anchor.description: Anchor for the previous page (null at the start)

has_next.description: Whether more cards follow this page

count.description: Number of cards on this page

column.description: The card's column key (= its status)

position.description: Fractional position within the column (stringified Decimal)

blocked_by_ids.description: Cards this card is blocked by

origin_ref.description: Opaque id of the projected source (null for local)

origin_meta.description: Projection metadata (owned by the projecting system)

completed_at.description: Set when the card entered a DONE column

VocabularyTermResponse.description: One term of a fixed vocabulary.

value.description: The machine value carried in requests and responses

label.description: The canonical English label (a client localizes by value)
